## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0, T ≈ 1.2 K

Raw first, then per-run `sdh_onset` + FFT in 1/B against F_L = (h/4e)·|n| and the `fs_count_b0` model tones. FFT windows start at 1.0 T: run 6's sub-1 T leg (50 mT) undersamples the 7.1 T tone (Nyquist ΔB at 0.5 T is ~24 mT), so sub-1 T content is read only qualitatively here.

**Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T):** strong SdH. Dominant tone **7.1 T** — the model ABAB light pocket sits at 7.31 T (global scale 0.97, inside the lever-arm prior); it is **censored at the record's low edge** (oscillations persist to 0.3 T; true onset unmeasured — quantum mobility is good). A comb at 14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T is flagged 2×/3×/4× of 7.1 — but the model ABAB heavy tone (25.8 T) lives in exactly that band, and harmonic-vs-pocket is **undecidable on one column** (the fan's per-column n-trajectory is the screen: a harmonic tracks k·f_light(n) exactly, a heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve). A censored low cluster {3.0, 4.2, 5.1, 9.5 T} rides to the record edge where sampling was coarse — real pockets vs undersampling artifacts is an open item the low-field extension (next cell) tests at proper Δ(1/B). No tone at F_L = 33.1 itself.

**Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T):** busy near-CNP set — the recipe's stated low-|n| exception regime (model pair 5.3/7.1 T close and balanced). Measured 4.7 + 6.6 = 11.3 T ≈ 0.91·F_L (pair-like at the same 0.9–0.97 scale), plus a strong 12.3 T tone ≈ F_L (breakdown/sum-tone candidate — symmetry-allowed in ABAB — or a singleton) and 8.5 T. Underdetermined here by design; the hole side maxes at n = −1.27×10¹² (TG limit), below the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² design window. Measured onset 0.71 T.

**Take:** the **electron side carries the fan** — reaches design density (+3.2×10¹²), tone content is strong with onset ≤ 0.3 T, and the model templates separate there (ABAB heavy 25.8 vs ABCA singleton 33.1). The one-column read is *consistent with* ABAB light + harmonics, but the heavy-pocket-vs-harmonic fork and the low-tone cluster are exactly what the fan + low-field extension resolve. No call from spot checks alone.

# === Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: raw, onset, FFT vs F_L + model ===
import sys, warnings
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs

SPOTS = {6: +3.2e16, 7: -1.2e16}   # m^-2
SR0_GAIN = -1e6                     # device card
onsets = {}

# --- raw first: R = sr1_X / I_measured, per run ---
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 6.5))
for row, (rid, n_m2) in enumerate(SPOTS.items()):
    run = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    print(summarize_run(run))
    o = np.argsort(run.col("magnet_field"))
    B = run.col("magnet_field")[o]
    I = run.col("sr0_X")[o] / SR0_GAIN
    R = run.col("sr1_X")[o] / I
    r_fs = 50e-6 / np.nanmedian(np.abs(I))    # sr1 sens 50 uV over measured I
    axs[row, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6, color="C0")
    axs[row, 0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ω)",
                    title=f"run {rid}: n = {n_m2/1e16:+.1f}e12, raw (I_med {np.nanmedian(np.abs(I))*1e9:.1f} nA)")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=r_fs)
    for wi in w: print(f"  [run {rid}] {wi.message}")
    print(on.summary())
    onsets[rid] = on
    # bg-subtracted vs 1/B above the well-sampled cut (1 T: run 6's sub-1 T leg is 50 mT — undersampled for the 7.1 T tone)
    cut = 1.0
    m = B >= cut
    dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    axs[row, 1].plot(1 / B[m], dR, lw=0.5, color="C1")
    axs[row, 1].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="ΔRxx (Ω)", title=f"run {rid}: bg-subtracted (B ≥ {cut} T)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# --- FFT in 1/B vs F_L and the fs_count model tones ---
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for col, (rid, n_m2) in enumerate(SPOTS.items()):
    run = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    o = np.argsort(run.col("magnet_field"))
    B = run.col("magnet_field")[o]
    I = run.col("sr0_X")[o] / SR0_GAIN
    R = run.col("sr1_X")[o] / I
    F_L = luttinger_frequency(abs(n_m2))
    for cut, ls in ((1.0, "-"), (1.5, ":")):     # stability: window change — real peaks hold, artifacts wander
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
        axs[col].plot(freqs, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), ls, lw=0.9, label=f"cut {cut:.1f} T")
    axs[col].axvline(F_L, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {F_L:.1f} T")
    _, orbs = abab_fs(n_m2)
    for F, _kF in orbs:
        axs[col].axvline(F, color="C3", ls="-.", lw=0.8)
    axs[col].plot([], [], "-.", color="C3", label=f"model ABAB {', '.join(f'{F:.1f}' for F, _ in orbs)} T")
    axs[col].set(xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm)", xlim=(0, 1.4 * F_L),
                 title=f"run {rid}: FFT in 1/B, n = {n_m2/1e16:+.1f}e12")
    axs[col].legend(fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

for rid, on in onsets.items():
    print(f"run {rid}: onset_b = {on.onset_b:.2f} T "
          f"({'CENSORED at record edge' if any(t.censored for t in on.tones) else 'measured'})")

## HERA — Landau-fan preflight: low-field extension of the electron spot check (`sdh-spot-check`), B 0.15 → 0.7 T

> **05:29** · sdh-spot-check low-B ext: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0.15->0.7 T uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.012 (438 pts), delay 0, sr1 2 uV · **ETA ~06:09** (≈40 min)

The fan is designed (next cell) — this 40-minute leg precedes it per the recipe: run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is **censored at the record's low edge** (`landau-fan` step 1 lever 1: a censored onset gets a cheap low-field extension before a long fan commits), and run 6's censored low-tone cluster {3.0, 4.2, 5.1, 9.5 T} rides into the sub-1 T region that run 6 sampled at 50 mT — undersampled for everything above ~3 T there. This leg re-measures the same spot (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0) over 0.15–0.7 T uniform in 1/B at Δ(1/B) = 0.012 /T (Nyquist ×2.5 on F_L = 33.1 T — nothing can alias down into the cluster band) and at 2 µV sensitivity (run 6's 50 µV had this window under 1.2 % FS — grainy-ADC risk; measured R here is 12–57 Ω → 29 % FS max). Two outputs: the **true onset** (quantum-mobility number for the output contract; the fan's B_lo = 0.5 T is cost-bound and already inside the oscillating region, so the fan design does not wait on the value) and a **real-vs-artifact verdict on the low cluster** (grid-change reproduction: a real tone survives uniform-B → uniform-1/B; an alias moves). Heavy tones (onsets ≥ 1.36 T, run 6) are dead in this window. Ends at 0.7 T with gates at the spot — the fan starts at 0.5 T. Checkpoint: first ~20 rows (signal on the 2 µV scale, leakage, field readback).

# === SdH spot check, low-field extension (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.15 -> 0.7 T uniform in 1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # same spot as run 6 — direct comparability
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in 1/B, 0.15 -> 0.7 T ascending. Delta(1/B) = 0.012 /T (Nyquist x2.5 on F_L = 33.1 T:
#     no fast tone can alias down into the 3-10 T band under test). Heavy tones (onsets >= 1.36 T, run 6) are dead here.
invB = np.linspace(1/0.15, 1/0.7, 438)
B_vec = np.round(1.0/invB, 5)
assert len(np.unique(B_vec)) == len(B_vec) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Sensitivity: run 6 measured R = 12-57 Ohm over B <= 0.75 T -> at 10 nA the 50 uV scale had this whole window
# under 1.2% FS (grainy-ADC risk). 2 uV = 200 Ohm FS: max 29% FS, 3.5x headroom over the measured max.
sr1.sensitivity(2e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]:.5f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.5f} T uniform-1/B; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check low-B extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), B 0.15 -> 0.7 T uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.012, sr1 2 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.15 -> 0.7 T uniform-1/B, d(1/B) = 0.012 /T, 438 pts; pins the censored onset + tests the 3.0-5.1/9.5 T cluster; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.7 T — the fan (next cell) starts at 0.5 T, 0.2 T away.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
